answer: To resist Sybil attacks, give every agent one marble slab carved at registration. The slab holds a cipher key that only that agent's completed work can unlock, and it records a fable of real contributions: tasks finished and peers helped. A new identity starts blank and must earn standing through verified work before voting or claiming rewards. One person cannot cheaply mint many slabs, since each demands a distinct cipher challenge tied to unique hardware and a public history. If a slab forges endorsements, it is cracked, its fable voided, and its owner starts over from blank marble.
